body: Three ideas-bot workflows carried a schedule: block and not one ever fired. Every post the account made was a side effect of a push trigger. When the branch merged and the pushes stopped, the posts stopped dead 14 hours before anyone asked why — and the merge made the dead schedules LOOK alive on main. Cadence for anything living off main goes through workers/cron.
title: GitHub runs schedule: only from the default branch

body: Not a merge commit — git diff-tree prints nothing for those, which is why real merges skip safely. A squash is one ordinary single-parent commit, so a path-triggered workflow sees all forty-odd files at once and reruns work weeks late at full agent cost. lab-build.yml carries an explicit merge-day guard for exactly this. Any loop workflow triggered by a path needs the same guard.
title: A squash merge is one commit touching every file the branch ever added

body: Nor do live PDS/Bluesky writes or remote D1 writes. The deploy workflows ARE the network: to deploy, push to a branch the workflow recognises. Do not spend turns debugging credentials that are not there.

title: Green is not proof: a deploy binds the custom domain or it changed nothing

body: loop.mino.mobi did not resolve on 2026-08-04, probed from the sandbox with sibling hosts on the same zone answering 200. This is a NEW domain, not an adoption. Attaching one is dashboard-only per DEPLOYS.md 7, so the first deploy-loop run may go green having bound nothing. The route is declared in loop/wrangler.jsonc anyway, which is what makes every later deploy re-bind it. When it is attached and a run has bound it, remove the continue-on-error from the verify step in deploy-loop.yml — otherwise a silent unbinding passes forever.
title: Attach loop.mino.mobi as a custom domain (dashboard-only)

body: The probe signal today measures liveness of the LOOP (does the graph lint, did the gate pass), not quality of an ARTIFACT. Naming that distinction is the difference between a judge and a smoke test. These are the artifact probes.
title: Build the real judge probes: loads, interactive, no console errors, frame budget, keyboard, 380px

body: Measured 2026-08-04 on loop.mino.mobi, a hostname that did not resolve before the run. wrangler deploy printed 'Deployed loop triggers / loop.mino.mobi (custom domain)' and the domain came up on its own. DEPLOYS.md 7 lists 'attach / detach custom domains' as dashboard-only; that is right for DETACHING and for moving a domain between workers, but a NEW hostname on a zone already in the account is created by the deploy from the routes[] declaration. Two things follow. First: the first deploy's verify step will still fail, because DNS takes ~10s to resolve and Cloudflare then serves error 1104 for a few minutes while the certificate is issued — attempts 1-2 got NXDOMAIN, 3-5 got 500, and the site answered 200 a few minutes later. Do not diagnose that as a binding failure. Second: the honest check is the wrangler log line, not the curl.
title: wrangler DOES create a new custom domain on deploy — DEPLOYS.md 7 overstates the dashboard-only rule
